# Feed Specification

<!-- Generated by scripts/openspec.js from specs/ (Spec Kit is the source of truth for these requirements). Edit specs/NNN-*/spec.md or openspec/capabilities.json, then run: node scripts/openspec.js sync -->

## Purpose

The superintelligence feed itself: which stories appear, how duplicates group, how they are tagged, filtered, searched and laid out on a laptop and a phone.

## Requirements

### Requirement: REQ-002 Show a feed of superintelligence stories
The system MUST show a feed of superintelligence stories, newest first, where each story shows its title, the sources that covered it, its superintelligence topics and a link to the original.

Source: `specs/001-superintelligence-homepage/spec.md`, approved (shared spec). Code: `server.js` default sort `new`; `storyCard` in `public/js/api.js`.

#### Scenario: REQ-002 is checked
- **WHEN** the checks named in docs/SPEC_TRACE.md run (e2e: public guest feed and story-detail checks in "Public orientation and account access"; "REQ-002: the feed is newest first by default"; "Reader robustness" covers stale responses, retry and pagination; "Reading quality" covers inline evidence, true factor values and story navigation; "Research wave 1" and `test/ui-date-unit.js` cover exact-date disclosure and sort explanations; unit: lineage (docs/LINEAGE.md))
- **THEN** they pass, as preflight and the browser test require

### Requirement: REQ-003 Include only items relevant to superintelligence
The system MUST include only items relevant to superintelligence, meaning items that match at least one superintelligence topic, and MUST leave all other items out of the feed.

Source: `specs/001-superintelligence-homepage/spec.md`, approved (shared spec). Code: `scope` in `lib/ontology.json`, `scope()` in `lib/analysis.js`, `stories.in_scope`, `storyRows` filter.

#### Scenario: REQ-003 is checked
- **WHEN** the checks named in docs/SPEC_TRACE.md run (e2e: "REQ-003 / SC-003" (both); unit: scope checks; HTTP regression `test/scope-admission.js` (unclassified/off-topic rows excluded); `test/story-page-unit.js` extends admission to dossiers and knowledge reads; unit: lineage (docs/LINEAGE.md))
- **THEN** they pass, as preflight and the browser test require

### Requirement: REQ-004 Show the same paper or announcement from several sources
The system MUST show the same paper or announcement from several sources as one story listing every source.

Source: `specs/001-superintelligence-homepage/spec.md`, approved (shared spec). Code: `storyKeys` in `lib/feeds.js`, `addItem` in `lib/harvest.js`.

#### Scenario: REQ-004 is checked
- **WHEN** the checks named in docs/SPEC_TRACE.md run (e2e: grouping checks in "Feed")
- **THEN** they pass, as preflight and the browser test require

### Requirement: REQ-005 Tag each story with the superintelligence topics it matches
The system MUST tag each story with the superintelligence topics it matches and MUST show the words that caused each tag, so readers can see why the story is on a superintelligence home page.

Source: `specs/001-superintelligence-homepage/spec.md`, approved (shared spec). Code: `lib/tagger.js`; scope reason on the story page.

#### Scenario: REQ-005 is checked
- **WHEN** the checks named in docs/SPEC_TRACE.md run (e2e: "US1-5 / REQ-005", "REQ-005: the story page says why"; `test/pipeline-quality-unit.js` checks full ancestor closure and valid graph references; unit: lineage (docs/LINEAGE.md))
- **THEN** they pass, as preflight and the browser test require

### Requirement: REQ-007 Link out to the original source and MUST NOT
The system MUST link out to the original source and MUST NOT host full article text.

Source: `specs/001-superintelligence-homepage/spec.md`, approved (shared spec). Code: Stories store title, summary (capped at 1,500 chars) and URL only.

#### Scenario: REQ-007 is checked
- **WHEN** the checks named in docs/SPEC_TRACE.md run (e2e: story links)
- **THEN** they pass, as preflight and the browser test require

### Requirement: REQ-017 Filter the feed by superintelligence topic
Readers MUST be able to filter the feed by superintelligence topic.

Source: `specs/001-superintelligence-homepage/spec.md`, approved (shared spec). Code: topic bar = the nine spec topics.

### Requirement: REQ-018 Be usable on a laptop
The feed MUST be usable on a laptop and a phone without sideways scrolling.

Source: `specs/001-superintelligence-homepage/spec.md`, approved (shared spec). Code: `public/css/app.css`.

#### Scenario: REQ-018 is checked
- **WHEN** the checks named in docs/SPEC_TRACE.md run (e2e: "Phone width" and "Reader robustness": 320, 390, 768 and 1280px, both themes, mobile menu and filter disclosure; "Reading quality" checks 676×504 content visibility, evidence reflow and reduced motion; "Research wave 1" checks direct guest navigation at 320/390px)
- **THEN** they pass, as preflight and the browser test require

### Requirement: REQ-041 Turn on a "For you" order computed from their
In the extended version, a signed-in reader SHOULD be able to turn on a "For you" order computed from their own votes and saves by a small model over the stored titles and summaries (no paid API, no full text), each pick showing the words that raised it; it SHOULD be off by default, need at least 5 votes or saves, and turning it off SHOULD delete the reader's model.

Source: `specs/004-parity/spec.md`, proposed, not approved: needs both partners. Code: proposed, not built (today: sorts top/new/votes/signal in `storyRows`, `server.js`).

#### Scenario: REQ-041 is checked
- **WHEN** the checks named in docs/SPEC_TRACE.md run (none yet (tasks T050, T051))
- **THEN** they pass, as preflight and the browser test require

### Requirement: REQ-042 Use a full-text index
In the extended version, search SHOULD use a full-text index (SQLite FTS5, Postgres `tsvector`) over titles, summaries, topic labels and matched words, rank by match, behave the same on both databases, and fall back to today's substring match where the index is missing.

Source: `specs/004-parity/spec.md`, proposed, not approved: needs both partners. Code: proposed, not built (today: substring `q` on `GET /api/stories`).

#### Scenario: REQ-042 is checked
- **WHEN** the checks named in docs/SPEC_TRACE.md run (none yet (tasks T010, T011))
- **THEN** they pass, as preflight and the browser test require

### Requirement: REQ-043 Show a coverage panel
In the extended version, each story page SHOULD show a coverage panel: every source with its kind, its source-type label and its first-seen time, ordered by first seen with the lag from the first; and the weekly brief SHOULD list significant stories covered by a single source.

Source: `specs/004-parity/spec.md`, proposed, not approved: needs both partners. Code: proposed, not built (today: "covered by" table in `public/story.html`).

#### Scenario: REQ-043 is checked
- **WHEN** the checks named in docs/SPEC_TRACE.md run (none yet (tasks T020, T021))
- **THEN** they pass, as preflight and the browser test require

### Requirement: REQ-046 Mute words
In the extended version, a signed-in reader SHOULD be able to mute words, tags and sources (at most 50 rules), applied to every feed sort and the brief, with a count of hidden stories and a way to show them.

Source: `specs/004-parity/spec.md`, proposed, not approved: needs both partners. Code: proposed, not built.

#### Scenario: REQ-046 is checked
- **WHEN** the checks named in docs/SPEC_TRACE.md run (none yet (tasks T012, T013))
- **THEN** they pass, as preflight and the browser test require
